name: ANZCO Foods
subsector: beef and lamb processing and export
desc: New Zealand meat processor and exporter of beef, lamb and food products, with ten New Zealand facilities and customers in over 80 countries.
products: beef, lamb, value-added meat and healthcare ingredients
customers: food service, retail and manufacturing customers in 80+ countries
marketing_autonomy_basis: own brand, own Christchurch management and own title sponsorship (ANZCO Foods IRONMAN New Zealand)
stores_or_sites: 10 New Zealand processing and manufacturing facilities, 6 offshore offices
markets: New Zealand processing; exports to more than 80 countries across Asia, North America, Europe and the Middle East

fin.value_orig: NZD 133m (15 months to 31 Mar 2026; figure truncated on listing page)

profitability_basis: EBITDA NZD 133m for 15 months to Mar 2026, described as a strong result

sponsorships.designation: title sponsor (ANZCO Foods IRONMAN New Zealand)

signals.what: Agreement to buy 100% of Greenlea Group (June 2026); all regulatory approvals received September 2026

fit_rationale: Exporter to 80+ countries already buying endurance-sport title rights; F1 hospitality in Japan, China, the Gulf and US could host the importers and retail buyers that take its beef and lamb.
f1_markets: Japan, China, USA, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Singapore, Australia
outstanding: Parent listing status from an exchange page; marketing lead name.
